name: Sorcerous Burst

cantrip_scaling.text: Each 8 rolled on one of the spell's d8s adds another d8, up to a number of extra dice per casting equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage of a type you pick; each 8 rolled can add another d8.
text: You hurl a burst of raw sorcery at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic or Thunder. Whenever one of the spell's d8s comes up 8, you can roll one more d8 and add it to the damage; in a single casting you can add no more of these extra d8s than your spellcasting ability modifier. The damage rises by 1d8 at character levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8) and 17 (4d8).
